prompt: Air pollution is one of the largest problems the world is facing today. What are some causes of air pollution and what measures can be proposed to solve this problem?
essay:
Nowadays, many countries are faced a significant issue in the world, which is global warming and is related to air pollution. This problem is mainly caused by  the private vehicles and emissions of industrials sector, but it can be addressed by adding some regulations to reduce carbon emissions.

There are several reasons for the occurrence of air pollution, and one of the reasons is that owning a private car for each citizen in the country. This is because using individual cars generates more carbon dioxide than using public transportation. In addition, numerous industrials have a considerable contribution to air pollution since they manufacture chemical materials, and these manufacturing processes have a hazardous effect on our health. With these approaches, air pollution will continue to increase considerably in the world.

On the other hand, there are a lot of measures that can be taken to alleviate air pollution. One of these solutions is that decreasing the cost of public transportation and then encourage people to utilise it instead of driving their own cars. Moreover, governments should enforce some rules on industrial companies, such as banning the production of chemicals to eliminate air pollution. Consequently, countries will have clean and healthy environments without the effect of carbon dioxide.

In conclusion, air pollution plays a vital role in health damage in the world due to the human footprint , which has serious consequences. Nevertheless, I believe that authorities are ultimately capable of mitigating the causes of air pollution by introducing some strict laws, and the more they concentrate on guidelines for its effect, the greater the positive impact on our health.
